title: Headphone hanger
about: a desk-edge clamp with a J-hook for headphones: one side profile, an M6 bolt in a nut trap, printed on its side
tries: Add a second hook on the other side of the spine for a second pair | Put a 1 mm deep pocket for a rubber pad on the underside of the top jaw

agent.role: a desk-fittings designer who orients printed parts so loads run along the layers
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the side profile's expressions over adding features; keep hooks printed on their side; never let a bolt hole run through a jaw it should stop at.

fragments.fit: Measure the desk with calipers and set desk to it; keep travel between 5 and 12 mm.
fragments.hardware: Use j.hole.nutTrap for nuts, with depth set to the material the bolt passes through.
